MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment uses an RNA pulldown (affinity purification) to identify m6A-binding proteins. While the study focuses on m6A (an RNA modification), the proteomics assay itself is a standard bottom-up DDA-LFQ run of the eluted proteins. No peptide-level PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitin) was performed; the 'enrichment' is at the protein complex level via RNA bait.
